description: Retention policy as data (issue #158, S1): every lotus-ai store family declares its retention period, legal-hold support, erasure key and evidence class, with the rationale stated. The model-enumeration invariant fails the build when a table exists outside this policy, so a new migration cannot add an undeclared store.

families.purpose: Execution audit records and privileged-access events: the authoritative trail of what served, what was refused, and who read control evidence.
families.retention_basis: Bank-facing execution and access evidence retained seven years, aligned with the lotus-core retention programme vocabulary.

families.purpose: Governed-action, operations, rollout, kill-switch, lifecycle and drift evidence: control decisions about the platform, not client content.
families.retention_basis: Control-plane decision evidence retained seven years; it carries no client-derived content, so no tenant erasure key applies.

families.purpose: Workflow-pack runs, their events, idempotency claims, task flows, checkpoints, queue events and produced artifact metadata: business run records carrying client-derived context.
families.retention_basis: Business run evidence retained seven years like the audit trail it corroborates; tenant-erasable on off-boarding subject to legal hold.

families.purpose: Queued async jobs and their attempts, which snapshot request content while work is in flight.
families.retention_basis: Runtime state, not the evidence of record: the audit and run families hold the durable trail, so terminal job snapshots expire after one year.

families.purpose: Worker and admission leases plus admission guard rows: replica-coordination state with no client content.
families.retention_basis: Transient coordination state; thirty days retains enough for incident reconstruction while preventing unbounded growth.

families.purpose: Evaluation runs and attempts: the PASS/FAIL evidence governed promotions and restores reference by run id.
families.retention_basis: Promotion and capability-restore evidence must outlive the decisions it enabled; retained seven years with the governance evidence it backs.

families.purpose: Per-case evaluation inputs and outputs: bulky generated content behind the run verdicts.
families.retention_basis: Case-level content is diagnostic, not the verdict of record; one year covers regression investigation. Minimisation (retain longer only for failures) is the S4 slice.

families.purpose: Ingested platform reference sources, documents, chunks, versions and ingestion/index jobs shared across tenants.
families.retention_basis: Shared reference content is versioned: superseded versions expire after three years; current versions are re-ingested, not retained past supersession. No tenant erasure - the content is not tenant-derived.

families.purpose: Repo-governed prompts and their versions, rollout state, workflow-pack registrations, caller policies, catalogue entries and rate cards: governed configuration that is operative, not accumulating.
families.retention_basis: Retained while operative: these rows ARE the current governed configuration, superseded through governed transitions whose evidence lives in the control_plane_evidence family, not through time-based expiry.

families.purpose: Quota counters, budget spend and breaker state: current operational posture, superseded in place.
families.retention_basis: Current-state rows updated in place by the control paths that own them; governed resets clear them and are themselves evidenced in control_plane_evidence.
